shapeSummary: Flat rectangular PCB, 65 mm (X) by 56 mm (Z) by 1.6 mm thick (Y). The bottom face is at Y=0 and the board is centered on X and Z. Four 2.75 mm through holes sit at (±29, ±24.5) mm in the Raspberry Pi HAT pattern.
warnings: The 65 x 56 mm outline comes from unverified supplied data.
The 1.6 mm thickness is assumed, since no height was given.
The four mounting hole positions and 2.75 mm diameter come from the Raspberry Pi HAT specification, not from measurement.
The corners look rounded, but the radius is unknown, so they are left square.
The prototyping hole grid and SMT components (microcontroller, capacitor, regulator, switches, USB connector, LEDs) are omitted because their sizes and counts are uncertain.
Silkscreen and labels are not modeled.
cadquery:
t = 1.6
board = cq.Workplane('XY').box(65, t, 56, centered=(True, False, True))
pts = [(-29, -24.5), (29, -24.5), (-29, 24.5), (29, 24.5)]
holes = cq.Workplane('XZ', origin=(0, -0.5, 0)).pushPoints(pts).circle(1.375).extrude(-(t + 1.0))
part = board.cut(holes)
